subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this broad issue stay open as the umbrella for WeChat identity drift and flood/deadlock triage, or should maintainers split those remaining claims into narrower live-repro issues while relying on the existing canonical issues for sessions_send and activity sorting?
rationale: The source gaps are real in related areas, but the issue combines multiple owner boundaries and one already-merged adjacent fix; automation cannot safely choose the permanent issue structure or background-event isolation behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split remaining claims
options.body: Keep the two existing canonical issues for sessions_send and activity sorting, then open or request narrow live-repro issues for WeChat identity drift and session flooding/deadlock.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Use this issue as the maintainer-owned umbrella and link the narrower issues as sub-work, accepting that it is not a safe autonomous fix lane.

options.title: Close after linking canonicals
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide the WeChat/flood claims are sufficiently covered or not actionable without fresh reporter data.

recommendation.title: Split remaining claims
recommendation.body: Keep the two existing canonical issues for sessions_send and activity sorting, then open or request narrow live-repro issues for WeChat identity drift and session flooding/deadlock.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent session UI/product history among the likely owners and can route the split between UX activity semantics and core routing follow-up.
